answer: A payout is split so that 36% arrives at settlement and the rest over 10 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The mesa schedule is applied in ripple and island publishes each instalment. An attacker therefore cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 1409 identities would post 3758 proofs and burn roughly 25 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
